_description: Manifest of PatientPunk universal base fields: descriptions, confidence tiers and ICD-10 hints. How this field set was chosen is documented in METHODS.md.
_loaded_by: Read at runtime by Schema.from_file (schema.py), the codebook generator (codebook.py), and per-field confidence lookup. The field list the extractor actually prompts on is BASE_FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS in llm_extract.py — keep the two in step; a field added here but not there is documented and never extracted.

age.description: Patient's current age in years (numeric string)
age.notes: Restricted to 16-99 to reduce noise from non-demographic age mentions

sex_gender.description: Patient's biological sex or gender identity

conditions.description: Diagnosed medical conditions only — not symptoms

onset_trigger.description: What triggered or preceded illness onset (infection, vaccine, surgery, etc.)

dosage.description: Medication or supplement doses the author explicitly reports taking or receiving, as 'treatment: dose' pairs
dosage.notes: Each dose remains linked to its treatment. Decomposed downstream into dosage_treatment and dosage_value columns.

treatment_outcome.description: Response to treatments as 'drug: outcome: symptom' triples
treatment_outcome.notes: PC-COS core outcome. Decomposed downstream by normalize.decompose_treatment_outcome into label / drug / symptom columns.

procedures.description: Medical procedures undergone (tilt table test, colonoscopy, etc.)

mental_health.description: Mental health conditions or experiences mentioned
mental_health.notes: The only retained field present in every framework considered

prior_infections.description: Prior infections that may be relevant to current illness (EBV, COVID, Lyme, etc.)

functional_status_tier.description: Functional capacity level (bedbound, housebound, severe, moderate, mild, mostly_functional)
functional_status_tier.notes: Promoted from the covidlonghaulers extension in manifest 3.0 — EQ-5D mobility+self-care and SF-36 physical functioning make it universal, not COVID-specific.

social_impact.description: Social impacts of illness (isolation, relationship strain, lost friends)
social_impact.notes: Promoted from base-optional in manifest 3.0. EQ-5D usual activities; SF-36 social functioning; PROMIS social participation.

alternative_treatments.description: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (pacing, acupuncture, HBOT, cold exposure)
alternative_treatments.notes: Promoted from base-optional in manifest 3.0. No framework equivalent — clinical trials do not capture self-directed non-pharmaceutical interventions, which is exactly why patient-authored text is worth mining for it.

dietary_interventions.description: Dietary changes tried (low-histamine, elimination, carnivore, gluten-free)
dietary_interventions.notes: No framework equivalent; retained for the same reason as alternative_treatments.

misdiagnosis.description: Conditions the patient was incorrectly diagnosed with before the current diagnosis
misdiagnosis.notes: No outcome-framework equivalent, but grounded in the diagnostic-odyssey literature and not capturable from clinical records.

illness_duration.description: How long the patient has been ill overall — a whole-illness marker, not per-symptom
illness_duration.notes: Renamed from symptom_duration. The symptom_ prefix read as though it belonged to one symptom; it has always described the illness course as a whole.

illness_trajectory.description: Whether the illness overall is improving, worsening, stable, relapsing-remitting, or recovered
illness_trajectory.notes: Renamed from symptom_trajectory. Per-symptom trajectories are not extracted separately — patients report a global illness course, and splitting it would drop each cell into single-digit fill.

fatigue_pem.description: Fatigue, post-exertional malaise, crashes, exercise intolerance
fatigue_pem.notes: SF-36 vitality; PC-COS outcomes #1 and #3; ME/CFS CCC cardinal criterion. PEM is the delayed symptom worsening after exertion — distinct from ordinary tiredness but recorded in the same field.

cognitive_neurological.description: Brain fog, memory and concentration problems, neuropathy, tinnitus, dizziness, headaches

cardiovascular_autonomic.description: POTS symptoms, palpitations, orthostatic intolerance, temperature dysregulation
cardiovascular_autonomic.notes: ME/CFS CCC autonomic criterion. Records the symptom even when the patient also names POTS as a diagnosis in `conditions`.

pain.description: Pain anywhere the patient reports it, whatever the site — joint, muscle, chest, nerve, head, abdominal, pelvic, throat, ear, back
pain.notes: The only symptom domain present in all six frameworks

sleep.description: Insomnia, hypersomnia, unrefreshing sleep, sleep-cycle disruption
sleep.notes: PC-COS outcome #8; ME/CFS CCC sleep criterion

other_symptoms.description: Symptoms outside the five domains above — respiratory, gastrointestinal, skin, hair loss, vision
other_symptoms.notes: Catch-all. PROMIS covers the GI subset. Watch this field's value distribution across runs — a domain that keeps recurring here is a candidate for promotion to its own field.

base_optional_fields._description: Defined but NOT extracted by default. Activate in an extension schema via 'include_base_fields'.

genetic_testing.description: Genetic testing mentions (23andMe, MTHFR, HLA typing, etc.)

toxic_exposures.description: Environmental toxic exposures (chemicals, pesticides, mold, etc.)
